name: Swiss grid
idea: A strict grid, flush-left type and heavy rules: the information is the design.
brief: Swiss International Style. Hang every element on the 12-column grid (--cols) and align everything flush left to a few shared edges. Heavy rules (var(--rule) and thicker multiples) are structure: they divide the page, underline a section, head a column. Type is the image: a grotesk set tight, very large for numbers and short claims, small and precise for labels. Asymmetry with a strong left axis; generous empty fields on the right or bottom. Numbers are huge and set on the grid. Images, when present, are square-cropped and sit exactly in grid modules.

styles: monochrome detail photography, tight crop, hard light
